workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: verify: prepare the finite 7dc runtime upgrade

head_commit.message:
verify: prepare the finite 7dc runtime upgrade

Select the genuine published 7dc runtime and resolve its executable and source
metadata from the same immutable reference. Its initial acceptance remains
mandatory; a failed start or preparation ends the finite campaign without
replay or adopting an incomplete artifact.

Before each historical shutdown crossing, use its guarded public SSH route to
stop only the console router and require a clean inactive service. Retain
native guest failure and caller observation expiry separately. The final
controller stops and updates the old runner; ordinary final-code stop uses no
historical service preparation.

Keep disk, credential, account, sentinel, import and live closure continuity.
This proves an operator-prepared K-runtime upgrade with vpsAdmin unchanged,
not K68 compatibility or ordinary unprepared historical shutdown.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: runtime: add portable KB launcher and capture leases

head_commit.message:
runtime: add portable KB launcher and capture leases

Use one standalone engine for checkout and packaged cluster commands. Private
versioned identities, prepared artifacts and fresh run receipts bind owned
resources to immutable source and full-lifetime capture leases. Cold resume
retains the accepted artifact; updates prepare exact guest closures before
stopping and preserve owned disks and credentials. Require unchanged resolved
SSH endpoints so retained host-key trust remains valid after the restart.
Public lifecycle contention refuses before mutation rather than queuing it.

Capture and validation share explicit connection and artifact-root contracts,
with canonical source proof and bilingual result preservation. Keep the
artifact flock in the writing process through publication and cleanup so a
helper failure cannot admit a competing writer during synchronous writes.
Observed lease loss cancels capture and prevents subsequent publication.

Verify the installed tools directly on an ordinary Linux/Nix/KVM host through
public commands, with exact predecessor continuity and measured capacity.
The selected IP inventory fixture uses a small member VPS and dedicated
administrator API provisioning while retaining a proved member browser.
Expose a separate strict hosted check for the accepted committed media.

Discover all machine SSH keys within one readiness deadline, retaining private
native diagnostics and refusing partial or changed trust. Preserve child PID
authority atomically across supported interruption and close owned resources.
Give the runner its
own POSIX session before machine creation; containing cgroup and host failures
still require complete ownership and exit proof. Quiesce its control thread
before closing the listener, and preserve primary fixture failures and native
private diagnostics without accepting unknown socket contents.

Pin the private directory and socket inode during authenticated live shutdown.
The same locked stop or update may retire only that unchanged control socket
after acknowledged shutdown and complete exit proof for the same launch and
runner. The verifier uses final-controller stop, genuine predecessor resume
and final-controller update. Interruption discards this permission; a dead
residual cannot reconstruct it from saved path or inode facts.

Legacy state and sockets remain untouched rather than being adopted by the
new engine.

Use one standalone engine for checkout and packaged cluster commands. Private
versioned identities, prepared artifacts and fresh run receipts bind owned
resources to immutable source and full-lifetime capture leases. Cold resume
retains the accepted artifact; updates prepare exact guest closures before
stopping and preserve owned disks and credentials. Require unchanged resolved
SSH endpoints so retained host-key trust remains valid after the restart.
Public lifecycle contention refuses before mutation rather than queuing it.

Capture and validation share explicit connection and artifact-root contracts,
with canonical source proof and bilingual result preservation. Keep the
artifact flock in the writing process through publication and cleanup so a
helper failure cannot admit a competing writer during synchronous writes.
Observed lease loss cancels capture and prevents subsequent publication.

Verify the installed tools directly on an ordinary Linux/Nix/KVM host through
public commands, with exact predecessor continuity and measured capacity.
The selected IP inventory fixture uses a small member VPS and dedicated
administrator API provisioning while retaining a proved member browser.
Expose a separate strict hosted check for the accepted committed media.

Discover all machine SSH keys within one readiness deadline, retaining private
native diagnostics and refusing partial or changed trust. Give the runner its
own POSIX session before machine creation; containing cgroup and host failures
still require complete ownership and exit proof.

Legacy state and sockets remain untouched rather than being adopted by the
new engine.

Quiesce the owned control thread before closing its listener so shutdown can
remove its own socket. Preserve primary fixture failures and native private
diagnostics while retaining refusal of unknown socket contents.

head_commit.message:
runtime: add portable KB launcher and capture leases

Use one standalone engine for checkout and packaged cluster commands. Private
versioned identities, prepared artifacts and fresh run receipts bind owned
resources to immutable source and full-lifetime capture leases. Cold resume
retains the accepted artifact; updates prepare exact guest closures before
stopping and preserve owned disks and credentials. Require unchanged resolved
SSH endpoints so retained host-key trust remains valid after the restart.
Public lifecycle contention refuses before mutation rather than queuing it.

Capture and validation share explicit connection and artifact-root contracts,
with canonical source proof and bilingual result preservation. Keep the
artifact flock in the writing process through publication and cleanup so a
helper failure cannot admit a competing writer during synchronous writes.
Observed lease loss cancels capture and prevents subsequent publication.

Verify the installed tools directly on an ordinary Linux/Nix/KVM host through
public commands, with exact predecessor continuity and measured capacity.
The selected IP inventory fixture uses a small member VPS and dedicated
administrator API provisioning while retaining a proved member browser.
Expose a separate strict hosted check for the accepted committed media.

Legacy state and sockets remain untouched rather than being adopted by the
new engine.
